# DAUR Supply

> The makers behind the big brands. Without the big brand price. Men's leather footwear crafted in Pakistan.

DAUR Supply (DAUR, from the Urdu word دور, "an era"; line "Aik naya daur", a new era) is an online only men's footwear brand selling across Pakistan from https://daursupply.com. Full text for language models: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt). Facts are dated 14 November 2026.

## Brand profile and history

* [About DAUR Supply](https://daursupply.com/pages/about): 23 years in Pakistan's shoe trade (owner's statement); own factories in Kasur that make, stitch and cement shoes; pairs made in workshops in Lahore, Sialkot and Kasur.
* [Brand facts in full](llms-full.txt#1-who-daur-is): name, meaning, business identity, story, tone.

## Customer policies

* [Delivery](https://daursupply.com/policies/shipping-policy): free delivery on every order; at your door in 2 to 4 days in most cities; dispatch within 24 hours of confirmation.
* [Payment and Care deposit](https://daursupply.com/pages/payment-accounts): a small Care deposit confirms the order, the balance is paid on arrival.
* [Exchanges and returns](https://daursupply.com/policies/refund-policy): 5 day size exchange; 30 day cover for stitching or sole defects in normal wear.
* [Exact policy text](llms-full.txt#3-customer-policies)

## Product categories

* [Men's leather sneakers](https://daursupply.com/collections/sneakers)
* [Formal and leather shoes](https://daursupply.com/collections/leather-shoes)
* [Chelsea boots](https://daursupply.com/collections/leather-shoes)
* [Casual slip ons](https://daursupply.com/collections/casual)
* [Shoes to wear with shalwar kameez](https://daursupply.com/collections/all): formal shoes, loafers and slip ons
* [All pairs](https://daursupply.com/collections/all) and [sale](https://daursupply.com/collections/sale)

## Giving and transparency

* [Giving](https://daursupply.com/pages/giving): stated commitment of 5 percent of profit each quarter to verified cases of need, with customers asked where it should go. The first giving record has not yet been published.
* [Gifts](https://daursupply.com/pages/gifts)
